_comment: WO-2 done-criterion 5 (2026-10-05 build brief). PREPARED, NOT RUN: held until

training_objective. The objective field only exists after WO-1

the cell rather than silently training the fast all-positions objective.
The one variable is the encoder: hand-written (WO-2) instead of the packaged
PyTorch encoder. Initialization is bit-identical to v1 at the same seed;
training rounds differently, so the result is compared with the RANGE of
WO-1's four reference pilots (seeds 42, 7, 13, 21), not with any one of them.
Record the result in docs/results.md beside the WO-1 references, pass or fail.
